capabilities: Search selected text from the right-click menu or command palette
Search a note's title from the file explorer or tab context menu
Add custom search engines with a {query} URL template in settings
Strip Markdown syntax from selections before searching
Assign hotkeys to the search commands
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the plugin sends nothing anywhere itself; it only opens the search URL in the browser.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send selected text or a note title to a web search engine, let alone a choice of engines.
summary: Web search helper that searches selected text or a note title from the right-click menu or commands, using built-in and user-defined search engines.
